#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rotate-hdcs-runs.sh — dry-run default (zero writes), --apply rotates stale
# PATTERN files from RUNS_DIR into ARCHIVE_DIR preserving relpath, then prunes
# to newest KEEP. No root, no logrotate. Refusals cite A-numbers (A4 path law).
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CONF="$SCRIPT_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"

die() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# --- conf parse: KEY=VALUE lines, blanks/# skipped, exactly 5 keys required ---
CONF_KEYS=0
CONF_DATA=""
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in
      ''|'#'*) continue ;;
    esac
    if printf '%s\n' "$line" | grep -qE '^[A-Z_]+='; then
      key="${line%%=*}"
      val="${line#*=}"
      CONF_DATA="$CONF_DATA$key=$val"$'\n'
      CONF_KEYS=$((CONF_KEYS + 1))
    else
      die "conf parse: malformed line: $line"
    fi
  done < "$CONF"
fi
[ "$CONF_KEYS" -eq 5 ] || die "conf parse: expected exactly 5 KEY=VALUE lines, found $CONF_KEYS"

conf_get() {
  _k="$1"
  printf '%s' "$CONF_DATA" | while IFS= read -r l; do
    [ -z "$l" ] && continue
    case "$l" in "$="_k"="*) ;; esac
    case "$l" in
      "${_k}=") printf '%s' "${l#*=}"; break ;;
    esac
  done
}

RUNS_DIR="$(conf_get RUNS_DIR)"
ARCHIVE_DIR="$(conf_get ARCHIVE_DIR)"
AGE_DAYS="$(conf_get AGE_DAYS)"
PATTERN="$(conf_get PATTERN)"
KEEP="$(conf_get KEEP)"

# --- env overrides: env > conf; set-but-empty refuses (zero writes) ---
if [ -z "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR-}" ] && [ "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+x}" = "x" ]; then
  die "HDCS_RUNS_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
fi
if [ -z "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR-}" ] && [ "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+x}" = "x" ]; then
  die "HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
fi
[ "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+x}" = "x" ] && RUNS_DIR="$HDCS_RUNS_DIR"
[ "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+x}" = "x" ] && ARCHIVE_DIR="$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR"

# --- PATH_LAW (A4): all checks BEFORE any write ---
case "$RUNS_DIR" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: degenerate RUNS_DIR '$RUNS_DIR' refused" ;; esac
case "$ARCHIVE_DIR" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: degenerate ARCHIVE_DIR '$ARCHIVE_DIR' refused" ;; esac

RP_RUNS="$(realpath -m "$RUNS_DIR")" || die "A4: cannot resolve RUNS_DIR"
RP_ARCH="$(realpath -m "$ARCHIVE_DIR")" || die "A4: cannot resolve ARCHIVE_DIR"
case "$RP_RUNS" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: RUNS_DIR canonicalizes to degenerate '$RP_RUNS' refused" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR canonicalizes to degenerate '$RP_ARCH' refused" ;; esac
[ "$RP_RUNS" = "$RP_ARCH" ] && die "A4: RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR refused"
# component-prefix containment, either direction
case "$RP_RUNS/" in "$RP_ARCH/"*) die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR contains RUNS_DIR refused" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH/" in "$RP_RUNS/"*) die "A4: RUNS_DIR contains ARCHIVE_DIR refused" ;; esac

# --- stale cutoff: explicit seconds math, never bare -mtime +N ---
now="$(date +%s)"
cutoff=$((now - AGE_DAYS * 86400))

APPLY=0
[ "${1-}" = "--apply" ] && APPLY=1

STALE_LIST="$(mktemp -d)/stale.list" || die "cannot create scratch"
SCRATCH="$(dirname "$STALE_LIST")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SCRATCH"' EXIT

: > "$STALE_LIST"
find "$RP_RUNS" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  mt="$(stat -c %Y "$f")"
  if [ "$mt" -le "$cutoff" ]; then
    rel="${f#"$RP_RUNS"/}"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$mt" "$rel" >> "$STALE_LIST"
  fi
done

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 0 ]; then
  # dry-run: list only, zero writes
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    rel="${line#*$'\t'}"
    echo "$rel"
    n=$((n + 1))
  done < "$STALE_LIST"
  echo "-- dry-run: $n file(s) would rotate (use --apply)"
  exit 0
fi

# --- apply: move stale files with epoch suffix, then prune ---
mkdir -p "$RP_ARCH"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && continue
  mt="${line%%$'\t'*}"
  rel="${line#*$'\t'}"
  dest="$RP_ARCH/$rel.$mt"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  mv "$RP_RUNS/$rel" "$dest"
done < "$STALE_LIST"

# prune: per archived base name, keep newest KEEP by epoch suffix, remove oldest
find "$RP_ARCH" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  b="$(basename "$f")"
  case "$b" in
    *.*) suf="${b##*.}" ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$suf" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rotate-hdcs-runs.sh — dry-run default (zero writes), --apply rotates stale
# PATTERN files from RUNS_DIR into ARCHIVE_DIR preserving relpath, then prunes

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CONF="$SCRIPT_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"

die() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# --- conf parse: KEY=VALUE lines, blanks/# skipped, exactly 5 keys required ---
# Pure-bash case matching (no grep pipelines whose status could be masked).
CONF_KEYS=0
C_RUNS_DIR=""
C_ARCHIVE_DIR=""
C_AGE_DAYS=""
C_PATTERN=""
C_KEEP=""
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in
      ''|'#'*) continue ;;
    esac
    case "$line" in
      [A-Z_]*=*)
        key="${line%%=*}"
        val="${line#*=}"
        case "$key" in
          RUNS_DIR)    C_RUNS_DIR="$val" ;;
          ARCHIVE_DIR) C_ARCHIVE_DIR="$val" ;;
          AGE_DAYS)    C_AGE_DAYS="$val" ;;
          PATTERN)     C_PATTERN="$val" ;;
          KEEP)        C_KEEP="$val" ;;
          *) die "conf parse: unexpected key: $key" ;;
        esac
        CONF_KEYS=$((CONF_KEYS + 1))
        ;;
      *)
        die "conf parse: malformed line: $line"
        ;;
    esac
  done < "$CONF"
fi
[ "$CONF_KEYS" -eq 5 ] || die "conf parse: expected exactly 5 KEY=VALUE lines, found $CONF_KEYS"

RUNS_DIR="$C_RUNS_DIR"
ARCHIVE_DIR="$C_ARCHIVE_DIR"
AGE_DAYS="$C_AGE_DAYS"
PATTERN="$C_PATTERN"
KEEP="$C_KEEP"

# --- env overrides: env > conf; set-but-empty refuses (zero writes) ---
if [ "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+x}" = "x" ]; then
  [ -n "$HDCS_RUNS_DIR" ] || die "HDCS_RUNS_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
  RUNS_DIR="$HDCS_RUNS_DIR"
fi
if [ "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+x}" = "x" ]; then
  [ -n "$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR" ] || die "HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR is set but empty (refusing)"
  ARCHIVE_DIR="$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR"
fi

# --- PATH_LAW (A4): all checks BEFORE any write ---
case "$RUNS_DIR" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: degenerate RUNS_DIR '$RUNS_DIR' refused" ;; esac
case "$ARCHIVE_DIR" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: degenerate ARCHIVE_DIR '$ARCHIVE_DIR' refused" ;; esac

RP_RUNS="$(realpath -m "$RUNS_DIR")" || die "A4: cannot resolve RUNS_DIR"
RP_ARCH="$(realpath -m "$ARCHIVE_DIR")" || die "A4: cannot resolve ARCHIVE_DIR"
case "$RP_RUNS" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: RUNS_DIR canonicalizes to degenerate '$RP_RUNS' refused" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH" in ''|'.'|'/') die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR canonicalizes to degenerate '$RP_ARCH' refused" ;; esac
[ "$RP_RUNS" = "$RP_ARCH" ] && die "A4: RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR refused"
# component-prefix containment, either direction
case "$RP_RUNS/" in "$RP_ARCH/"*) die "A4: ARCHIVE_DIR contains RUNS_DIR refused" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH/" in "$RP_RUNS/"*) die "A4: RUNS_DIR contains ARCHIVE_DIR refused" ;; esac

# --- stale cutoff: explicit seconds math, never bare -mtime +N ---
now="$(date +%s)"
cutoff=$((now - AGE_DAYS * 86400))

APPLY=0
[ "${1-}" = "--apply" ] && APPLY=1

# scratch OUTSIDE RUNS_DIR/ARCHIVE_DIR/artifact tree
SCRATCH="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hdcs-rotate.XXXXXX")" || die "cannot create scratch"
STALE_LIST="$SCRATCH/stale.list"
trap 'rm -rf "$SCRATCH"' EXIT

: > "$STALE_LIST"
find "$RP_RUNS" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  mt="$(stat -c %Y "$f")"
  if [ "$mt" -le "$cutoff" ]; then
    rel="${f#"$RP_RUNS"/}"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$mt" "$rel" >> "$STALE_LIST"
  fi
done

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 0 ]; then
  # dry-run: list only, zero writes
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    rel="${line#*$'\t'}"
    echo "$rel"
    n=$((n + 1))
  done < "$STALE_LIST"
  echo "-- dry-run: $n file(s) would rotate (use --apply)"
  exit 0
fi

# --- apply: move stale files with epoch suffix, then prune ---
mkdir -p "$RP_ARCH"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && continue
  mt="${line%%$'\t'*}"
  rel="${line#*$'\t'}"
  dest="$RP_ARCH/$rel.$mt"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  mv "$RP_RUNS/$rel" "$dest"
done < "$STALE_LIST"

# prune: per archived base name, keep newest KEEP by epoch suffix, remove oldest
find "$RP_ARCH" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  b="$(basename "$f")"
  case "$b" in
    *.*) suf="${b##*.}" ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$suf" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$suf" "$f"
done | sort -k1,1nr -k2,2 | awk -v keep="$KEEP" -F'\t' '
  { base=$2; sub(/\.[0-9]+$/, "", base); n[base]++; if (n[base] > keep) print $2 }
' | while IFS= read -r old; do
  rm -f -- "$old"
done

exit 0
